tag: 簡報／提案：職涯發展政策修訂說明簡報

level.why: 長句結合被動、分詞構句與讓步轉折，字彙偏抽象（opaque、foster、irrelevant），需整合升遷、加薪、行政申請三項政策細節，且干擾項取自舊制與其他情境。

passage:
Good morning, everyone, and thank you for joining this briefing on the revised Career Development Policy, which takes effect on January first. Over the next fifteen minutes, I will explain what is changing, why the steering committee recommended these changes, and what you will need to do.

Let me begin with the problem. Last year's engagement survey showed that many employees considered our promotion process opaque, largely because decisions often rested on informal impressions rather than documented evidence. To foster a fairer system, the committee has introduced three measures.

First, any employee applying for a promotion or an internal transfer must now submit a reference letter from a current executive, ideally one who has supervised the candidate directly. Comments about personality or topics irrelevant to the role will no longer be accepted. The letter must address specific achievements and the practical experience gained on the job.

Second, a pay raise will no longer be tied solely to seniority. Beginning next year, adjustments will be determined by performance reviews, completed training, and the additional responsibilities an employee has assumed.

Third, we are simplifying administrative requests. Employees who need proof of employment, for example when applying for a mortgage or a visa, can now request it electronically through the HR portal, and it will be issued within one business day instead of five. Similarly, enrollment in leadership workshops, previously handled by paper forms, will be completed entirely online.

I realize that some of you may worry about the additional paperwork. However, early feedback from the pilot department suggests that the new process saves managers time rather than costing it. To sum up, this policy aims to make career decisions more transparent and daily procedures faster. In a moment, I will walk through a sample application, so please hold your questions until the end.
zh:
各位早安，感謝大家參加這場關於修訂版職涯發展政策的說明會，該政策將於一月一日起生效。在接下來的十五分鐘裡，我會說明有哪些改變、指導委員會為何建議這些改變，以及各位需要做些什麼。

讓我先從問題談起。去年的員工投入度調查顯示，許多員工認為我們的升遷流程不透明，主要是因為決策往往取決於非正式的印象，而非有文件佐證的證據。為了營造更公平的制度，委員會推出了三項措施。

第一，任何申請升遷或內部調動的員工，現在都必須提交一封由現任主管階層出具的推薦信，最好是直接督導過該候選人的人。與個性有關或與職務無關的評論將不再被接受。推薦信必須針對具體成就以及在工作中累積的實務經驗來撰寫。

第二，加薪將不再僅與年資掛鉤。從明年開始，調整幅度將依據績效考核、已完成的訓練，以及員工所承擔的額外職責來決定。

第三，我們正在簡化行政申請。需要在職證明的員工，例如申請房貸或簽證時，現在可以透過人資入口網站以電子方式申請，並且會在一個工作天內核發，而不是原本的五天。同樣地，領導力工作坊的報名過去採用紙本表單，今後將完全在線上完成。

我明白你們當中有些人可能擔心增加的文書作業。不過，試行部門的初步回饋顯示，新流程替主管節省了時間，而不是耗費時間。總結來說，這項政策旨在讓職涯決策更透明，也讓日常程序更快速。稍後我會逐步示範一份申請範例，所以請把問題留到最後再提。

questions.q: According to the speaker, why did the committee introduce the new measures?
opts: Too few employees had enrolled in leadership workshops
Promotion decisions were seen as lacking transparency
Paper forms were costing the company too much money
Managers had asked for faster pay raises
why: 錯誤：工作坊報名只是被簡化的行政項目，並非改革原因。
正解：調查顯示員工認為升遷流程不透明，決策依賴非正式印象。
錯誤：紙本表單被改為線上，但演講者未說明成本是主因。
錯誤：未提到主管要求更快加薪。

questions.q: What must the reference letter address?
opts: The candidate's personality and working style
The candidate's seniority and years of service
why: 錯誤：信中要求針對候選人，而非撰寫者自身經歷。
錯誤：與個性有關的評論明確不再被接受。
錯誤：年資是過去加薪的依據，並非推薦信內容。
正解：信必須針對具體成就與工作中累積的實務經驗。

questions.q: What is stated about proof of employment under the new policy?
opts: It can be requested online and issued within one business day
It must be requested on paper and takes five business days
It is available only to employees applying for a promotion
It will be issued once a pilot department approves it
why: 正解：可透過人資入口網站線上申請，一個工作天內核發。
錯誤：五天是舊流程的時間，且已不再需要紙本。
錯誤：房貸或簽證只是舉例，並未限定升遷申請者。
錯誤：試行部門只提供回饋，並不負責核准證明。

questions.q: Expense claims must be filed ______ the end of the month to be reimbursed in the following pay cycle.
why: 錯誤：until 表示持續到某時，不適合表示截止期限。
正解：by 表示「在…之前」，用於截止日期。
錯誤：during 後接期間，語意不符。
錯誤：for 後接一段時間長度，不適用。

questions.q: The new attendance policy applies to all full-time staff, ______ those on probation.
why: 錯誤：include 為動詞原形，無法在此作插入語。
錯誤：included 放在名詞後才表示被包括，語序不符。
錯誤：inclusion 為名詞，無法接受詞 those。
正解：including 為介系詞，後接 those on probation 表示「包括」。

questions.q: Managers are expected to ______ the policy changes clearly to their teams before the deadline.
why: 正解：to 後需動詞原形，communicate 搭配受詞 the policy changes。
錯誤：communication 為名詞，不能接在 to 後作動詞。
錯誤：communicative 為形容詞，無法作動詞。
錯誤：communicatively 為副詞，無法作動詞。

presentation_phrases.phrase: Thank you for joining this briefing on...
presentation_phrases.meaning: 感謝各位參加這場關於…的說明會
presentation_phrases.usage: 開場時致意並說明簡報主題。

presentation_phrases.phrase: Over the next fifteen minutes, I will explain...
presentation_phrases.meaning: 在接下來的十五分鐘，我會說明…
presentation_phrases.usage: 預告簡報內容與時間，幫助聽眾掌握架構。

presentation_phrases.phrase: Let me begin with the problem.
presentation_phrases.usage: 進入正題前先交代背景或痛點。
用序數詞分點說明，使重點清楚、便於聽眾跟上。

presentation_phrases.phrase: I realize that some of you may worry about...
presentation_phrases.meaning: 我明白有些人可能擔心…
presentation_phrases.usage: 預先回應聽眾疑慮，展現同理並降低抗拒。

presentation_phrases.phrase: In a moment, I will walk through...
presentation_phrases.usage: 預告下一步或轉換到範例或細節。

presentation_phrases.phrase: Please hold your questions until the end.
presentation_phrases.meaning: 請把問題留到最後再提。
presentation_phrases.usage: 說明問答時機，維持簡報節奏。
